bio: Francesca Sposata was born on 6 August 1683 at San Mango di Aquino in Catanzaro, Calabria, the daughter of Michele Sposata and Meranda Piraijno. In 1713 she married Giovanni Cicco there. She is John's 9th-great-grandmother.
